kurals.tr: Kantukettu Untuyirththu Utrariyum Aimpulanum / Ondhoti Kanne Ula
kurals.m: The (simultaneous) enjoyment of the five senses of sight, hearing, taste, smell and touch can only be found with bright braceleted (women)

kurals.tr: Pinikku Marundhu Piraman Aniyizhai / Thannoikkuth Thaane Marundhu
kurals.m: The remedy for a disease is always something different (from it); but for the disease caused by this jewelled maid, she is herself the cure

kurals.tr: Thaamveezhvaar Mendrol Thuyilin Inidhukol / Thaamaraik Kannaan Ulaku
kurals.m: Can the lotus-eyed Vishnu's heaven be indeed as sweet to those who delight to sleep in the delicate arms of their beloved ?

kurals.tr: Neengin Theruum Kurukungaal Thannennum / Theeyaantup Petraal Ival?
kurals.m: From whence has she got this fire that burns when I withdraw and cools when I approach ?

kurals.tr: Vetta Pozhudhin Avaiyavai Polume / Thottaar Kadhuppinaal Thol
kurals.m: Each varied form of joy the soul can wish is found

kurals.tr: Urudhoru Uyirdhalirppath Theentalaal Pedhaikku / Amizhdhin Iyandrana Thol
kurals.m: The shoulders of this fair one are made of ambrosia, for they revive me with pleasure every time I embrace them

kurals.tr: Thammil Irundhu Thamadhupaaththu Untatraal / Ammaa Arivai Muyakku
kurals.m: The embraces of a gold-complexioned beautiful female are as pleasant as to dwell in one's own house and live by one's own (earnings) after distributing (a portion of it in charity)

kurals.tr: Veezhum Iruvarkku Inidhe Valiyitai / Pozhap Pataaa Muyakku
kurals.m: To ardent lovers sweet is the embrace that cannot be penetrated even by a breath of breeze

kurals.tr: Ootal Unardhal Punardhal Ivaikaamam / Kootiyaar Petra Payan
kurals.m: Love quarrel, reconciliation and intercourse - these are the advantages reaped by those who marry for lust

kurals.tr: Aridhoru Ariyaamai Kantatraal Kaamam / Seridhorum Seyizhai Maattu
kurals.m: As (one's) ignorance is discovered the more one learns, so does repeated intercourse with a welladorned female (only create a desire for more)
